english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an infectious disease itself.

exampleSentences.english: This contagion is severe; everyone in the village has been infected.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種傳染病好犀利，成村人都中招。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cyun4 jim5 beng6 hou2 sai1 lei6 seng4 cyun1 jan4 dou1 zung3 ziu1

english.note: Use this for a named infectious disease, especially one that can spread from person to person.

exampleSentences.english: Dengue fever is an infection that can spread from person to person.
exampleSentences.jyutping: dang1 gaak3 jit6 hai6 jat1 zung2 cyun4 jim5 beng6
